summary: A1 triage of ep 92 (filler, afg ch-194). The body is pure anime-original comedy - the Sakuragi gang's beachside part-time-jobs/typhoon story plus the setup for the anime-only Jousei friendship match; AFL types it Filler (an isolated filler island: 85-86, 92, 95, 97-101) and the slamdunk.fandom episode page's chapter field is blank. AFG's own chart qualifies its 194 value: 'Mixed, in this episode we only watch from minute 19:14 to the end' - only the final ~3 minutes (Sakuragi told he stays behind at Anzai's request) touch ch 194 'Gasshuku/Training' (vol 22, 21pp), whose bulk - the 20,000-shot camp with the gang present - is ep 93 (AFG: 93 = 194-195). Same shape as CCS ep 7 / InuYasha ep 79: a tag-sized partial on a filler row, so per Sean's sliver precedent the type stands and the anchor goes; the annotation preserves the tail fact and position is carried by ep 93. AFG-tier row: per the 2026-08-24 apply contract the applied repair must flip the anchor source to manual, or the next AFG re-derive restores the deleted value.
